summary: Trinseo PLC filed an 8-K reporting extensions of existing waiver agreements under its credit facilities. The expirations for the revolver, senior credit, and refinance credit facility waivers were extended to May 13, 2026, and the securitization facility waiver was extended to May 14, 2026. No new agreements were entered into; the extensions were permitted by prior terms. This is a routine compliance update regarding debt facility waivers, not a special situation. The filing lacks any definitive transaction, strategic review, or shareholder action. The company's shares were recently delisted from the NYSE but continue trading OTC.
